'''Kinkosa''' was one of several economic states on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kirtania]]. It contained [[Kinkosa City]], and a [[Kinkosa rain forest|rain forest]]. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the rulers of Kinkosa struck a deal with the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. In exchange for preferential treatment and better trading terms, they agreed to give over a large swath of their territory for use as a supply station.
